title: Run the environment repair Agentic Recipe

Before dependent work continues, he runs Agentic Recipe `environment_repair`: diagnose missing substrate, attempt a bounded repair, then recheck until the environment is ok — without calling a model. Related linkage failures remain `nubble_insp_environment_linkage`. [^rc-env-repair]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `environment_repair` via `EnvironmentRepairTemplate` / `environment_repair_runner` and product verb `run_recipe` (`EnvironmentRepairRecipeAdapter`).
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `environment_repair_recipe.yaml` drives `run_recipe`; expects environment_ok / repair_attempts plus shape keys.
